name: dsh-lobsterai-daddy
description: LobsterAIDaddy — a draggable floating ball whose drawer renders the LobsterDaddy multi-account console as native DOM inside DSH: action buttons first, then the account LobsterAI is currently signed in as, then the account list with balances, per-account check-in state and last check-in time. Includes a loopback-only same-origin reverse proxy, live status dot, account badge, a resizable persisted drawer, and a follow toggle that keeps the panel with the ball. 把 LobsterDaddy 多账号控制台变成 DSH 界面悬浮球的插件：可拖拽摆位并自动记忆，面板可跟随悬浮球移动；点开即以原生渲染的控制台操作（账号与积分额度、已签到状态与最近签到时间、当前登录账号自动显示、一键签到、免退出登录新账号、切号、同步网关）。
